description: Land Title Settlement Department - Lakshapatiya, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters for intestate properties, including specific parcel numbers, land extents, and cadastral details. It involves calling for claims to property of deceased individuals and the process of registering land titles under the Registration of Title Act. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it concerns land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
